postal_system.assignment_rule: Canada Post defines a six-character code made from a three-character Forward Sortation Area and a three-character Local Delivery Unit. The full code can identify an urban block face, a single building, a large-volume receiver or a rural community. Valid syntax, an FSA prefix or a census match alone is not proof of a current assignment, exact civic address, building relation, occupant or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The full code is delivery-unit-first and is not guaranteed to be a polygon. Statistics Canada's 2021 Census Forward Sortation Area boundary file represents CFSAs derived from respondent-reported postal codes and dissemination areas; it is not necessarily equivalent to Canada Post FSA geography and contains no LDU boundaries. A CFSA, PCCF coordinate, NAR point, census area, road, parcel, ODB footprint, OSM object, Voronoi cell, buffer, interpolation, API cache or model surface cannot be presented as official full-postal-code geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, building, unit, civic number and suffix, official street name, street type, street direction, additional delivery information, rural route, P.O. Box, delivery installation or station, municipality, province or territory and postcode separately in English and French display contracts. Synthetic fixtures contain no real Canada Post result, NAR row, address, building, organization or person.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as block_face, building, large_volume_receiver, rural_community, route, po_box, organization, delivery_point, postal_area, other_special or unknown. FSA and LDU semantics never force the same geometry type across assignments.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic address identifier, a stable explicit relation to a permitted building identifier and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, source release, validity, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. A postcode, FSA, CFSA polygon, PCCF coordinate, NAR proximity, ODB containment or shared street text is not an exact address-to-building-footprint relation.
postal_system.address_register_rule: Statistics Canada's National Address Register provides versioned non-confidential georeferenced civic addresses under the Statistics Canada Open Licence and may include stable address and location identifiers. Its mailing representation and location do not establish Canada Post delivery entitlement, occupant identity or an automatic join to every ODB footprint; source release, provider coverage and explicit cross-keys remain required.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Permitted Canada Post API or licensed-data observations and Statistics Canada releases may normalize input, validate or enrich a candidate, compare observations, compress reviewed geometry, detect drift and produce review surfaces. Every output preserves source and service version, request and input digests, observed_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and authoritative, official-derived or derived status. It never overwrites source evidence, manufactures Canada Post geometry or infers a civic number, unit, building, organization or occupant.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate time-bound Canada Post observations, typed postal objects, CFSA reference geometry, permitted NAR civic addresses, explicit address-to-building relations and administrative context to AGID cells without relabelling a source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is Canada Post postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Canada Post Postal Code Address Data, latitude-longitude data and PCCF are licensed products with purpose, transfer and redistribution restrictions. AddressComplete requires a key and applicable commercial terms. Public Canada Post guidance is not a data licence. Statistics Canada CFSA, NAR and ODB releases retain their exact release terms and source acknowledgements; embedded Canada Post intellectual property is not silently converted to open data. ODbL material remains partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO CA scope and records province, territory, Indigenous, reserve, settlement, unorganized-area and source-specific coverage explicitly. It does not silently extend a layer into maritime space, border assertions or uncovered communities. Postal, census, administrative, civic-address, building and AGID coverage, asserted_by, legal status and boundary vintage remain independent.
postal_system.privacy_rule: The NAR is described as non-confidential and excludes resident or business identity, but exact civic addresses, units, coordinates, access points, delivery installations, rural routes, organization assignments, API responses, credentials, licensed Canada Post rows and query logs can expose sensitive household, property or commercial context when joined. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Canada Post assignments and monthly licensed releases, AddressComplete observations, the 2021 CFSA reference geography, PCCF vintages, semi-annual NAR releases, ODB provider coverage, municipal and provincial changes, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, source version, service version, census reference date, digest and supersession independently; never present a census polygon or undated match as current timeless delivery truth.
